properties.description: Planned 2026-10-07, build order 3 of 7. F2: relation_candidates weights a shared neighbour by its rarity, as terms already are, so the author and the project count for little, and pools ideas and requirements together when the subject is intent. F3: search_design returns, for each hit, the records directly linked to it by a review relation, EVOLVES_INTO or DECOMPOSES, marked as linked rather than matched. Pinned by the measured case: the one-graph family ranked together.
properties.name: Relation suggestions discount ubiquitous neighbours and compare ideas with requirements (F2); search returns each hit's directly linked records (F3)
